observations.description: Wide shot of the penalty area showing a player in red shooting towards the goal. The goalkeeper in black dives to his left and makes a save, falling to the ground.

Close-up of the goalkeeper on the ground recovering from the save. He pushes himself up to a kneeling position and then stands, looking towards the field. A player in white (number 3) is visible nearby.
Cut to a wide shot of the midfield. Players in white are passing the ball around near the center circle while players in red defend. The scoreboard shows UAE 0 - 1 OMA at 19:36.
Continuation of the midfield play. A player in white receives a pass and moves forward. The camera follows the ball as it is passed between teammates.

The play develops into an attack. A player in white dribbles towards the penalty area, evades a sliding tackle from a red defender, and passes the ball across the box. Another white-shirted player attempts a shot or cross but is blocked.

Close-up of a player in white (number 2) jogging back into position. The scene then cuts to a wider view of the field where players are resetting for a corner kick or free kick situation near the penalty area.

uncertainties: Exact outcome of the shot/cross in phase 4:insert is unclear due to camera angle and player congestion.
Specific player identities beyond jersey numbers are uncertain.
